tasks.title: Initialise Node.js + TypeScript project with Express
tasks.description: Create package.json with name url-pulse, scripts (build, start, dev), and dependencies: express, better-sqlite3. Create tsconfig.json with strict:true, target ES2022, module CommonJS, outDir dist, rootDir src. Install all dependencies. The project must compile with tsc --noEmit with zero errors on an empty src/index.ts stub.
done_criteria: package.json exists with express and better-sqlite3 in dependencies
tasks.commit_message_template: C1-TASK-1: initialise TypeScript + Express project scaffold

tasks.title: Implement Express app factory with middleware and error handlers
tasks.description: Create src/app.ts that constructs and exports the Express app. Register express.json() middleware first. Add a catch-all 404 handler that responds with { error: 'Not Found' } and HTTP 404. Add a global 4-argument error-handling middleware that reads err.status (defaulting to 500) and responds with { error: err.message }. Do NOT call app.listen() in this file — export the app instance only.
done_criteria: src/app.ts exports the Express app instance
express.json() is the first registered middleware
404 handler responds with { error: 'Not Found' } and HTTP 404
Global error handler (4 args) formats errors as { error: err.message } with err.status ?? 500
app.listen() is NOT called in app.ts
tasks.commit_message_template: C1-TASK-2: implement Express app with JSON middleware and error handlers

tasks.title: Implement server entry point with port binding and startup log
tasks.description: Create src/index.ts that imports the app from src/app.ts, reads PORT from process.env.PORT (parsing as integer, defaulting to 3000 if absent or non-integer), calls app.listen(port), and logs 'url-pulse listening on port <port>' to stdout. This file must NOT export anything — it is the process entry point only.
verification_commands: node -e "process.env.PORT='abc'; require('./dist/index.js')" 2>&1 | grep 'listening on port 3000' && echo OK || echo FAIL
done_criteria: src/index.ts reads PORT env var with parseInt fallback to 3000
Invalid PORT value (non-integer) causes fallback to 3000 without crash
Startup message 'url-pulse listening on port <port>' is logged to stdout
tasks.commit_message_template: C1-TASK-3: implement server entry point with PORT env var and startup log

tasks.title: Mount Check and History routers in app.ts
tasks.description: Once C-2 and C-3 routers exist, import them in src/app.ts and register them with app.use(). The Check Router handles POST /check and the History Router handles GET /history and GET /history/:id. This task should be executed after C2-TASK-* and C3-TASK-* are complete and their router files exist.
done_criteria: checkRouter is imported and mounted via app.use() in src/app.ts
historyRouter is imported and mounted via app.use() in src/app.ts
404 handler remains registered AFTER route mounts
tasks.commit_message_template: C1-TASK-4: mount check and history routers in Express app
